reasons.C: The plague pit: the clearest sickly yellow-green miasma rising from the pools, over brown-black bog and dead trees.
reasons.B: The dead orchard: rows of dead trees give the ground a texture none of the others has, with yellow-green wisps among them.

fixes.C: Make the pit itself the landmark: a ring of headstones and crypts round one pool.

notes: A, the drowned farmsteads, is close to C but plainer.
